inputs.name: resolveCleanCodeSettings.raw
inputs.description: Raw value supplied to resolveCleanCodeSettings for the cleanCode setting; it is parsed on every call, and undefined becomes {}, while null, arrays, and primitives throw ExpectedCliError. The resolver reads mode (off, advisory, or gate; null defaults to off), minConfidence (finite number in (0, 1]; null defaults to 0.85), apiKeyEnv (^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$; null defaults to HARNESS_JEV_API_KEY), model (jev-[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+, with undefined defaulting to jev-1.13.0), and exclude (array of nonblank strings, with undefined defaulting to []); other keys are ignored.

inputs.name: resolveCleanCodeSettings.options
inputs.description: Optional CLI options passed to resolveCleanCodeSettings; gate forces gate mode, enabled upgrades off to advisory, and dryRun or refresh with off throws ExpectedCliError. All four flags used here are optional booleans, the default is {}, and the type's optional signal field is not inspected by this resolver.

outputs.name: cleanCodeDefaults
outputs.description: Exported default CleanCodeSettings object with mode off, model jev-1.13.0, minConfidence 0.85, apiKeyEnv HARNESS_JEV_API_KEY, and exclude []. It supplies the resolver's fallback for model, minConfidence, apiKeyEnv, and exclude; mode's equivalent off fallback is written directly in the resolver.

outputs.name: resolveCleanCodeSettings
outputs.description: Returned by the resolver after applying defaults and CLI mode overrides; it always contains all five required CleanCodeSettings fields. Mode is off, advisory, or gate, minConfidence is finite and in (0, 1], apiKeyEnv matches ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$, model matches jev-[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+, and exclude is an array of nonblank strings.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown by fail when the top-level configuration is not an object or a validated field fails. Its message is Invalid harness.audit.json cleanCode.<field>., with mode: enable review with --clean-code used for the dry-run or refresh case.
